summary: Mayor Harp can make any claim but to say @justinelicker "has never been a friend of education" is an out right lie. I worked with Justin for years at Southern. I use one metric to judge teachers, "Would I want my kid in their class" and Justin always gets a yes

body_html: Mayor Harp can make any claim but to say @justinelicker "has never been a friend of education" is an out right lie. I worked with Justin for years at Southern. I use one metric to judge teachers, "Would I want my kid in their class" and Justin always gets a yes
